$schema_doc: Built-in mental model seeds. Each entry is created once per bank if absent. Existing models are NEVER modified by the bootstrap path — operators who want to change a curated model must delete and re-seed (or call refreshMentalModel for a content-only refresh). Tags must intersect the tags actually attached to retains, otherwise refresh returns empty (Hindsight all_strict matching). Source queries live here and not in TS so changes are reviewable as data, not code. `max_tokens` bounds server-side reflect generation per model; a separate client-side render budget bounds the total injected block.

seeds.name: User Preferences
seeds.source_query: What durable personal preferences has the user expressed across sessions about response language, communication and reporting style, code style and design taste, and preferred tools? State each as a short preference, not as a procedure. Exclude step-by-step workflows, verification or review procedures, approval and delegation rules, project-specific facts, one-off requests, task progress, and per-action approvals.

seeds.name: Project Conventions
seeds.source_query: What conventions does this project follow for code style, build, testing, release, and review? Prefer concrete commands, paths, and tool versions. Exclude general working habits that are not specific to this project, task progress, and one-off approvals.

seeds.name: Project Decisions
seeds.source_query: What durable architectural or product decisions have been made for this project, and what rationale or trade-offs were recorded? Exclude general working habits that are not specific to this project, transient plans, unresolved ideas, active task state, and per-action approvals.
